I'll take on any job… for the right price.|Cad Bane|{{TCW|Evil Plans}}}} '''Cad Bane''', formerly known as '''Colby''', was a [[Duros]] [[Gender|male]] [[bounty hunter]] and [[mercenary]] in [[the galaxy]] whose career spanned from the [[Fall Of The Republic|fall]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] and into the [[New Republic Era|era]] of the [[New Republic]]. Once a street rat, Bane first became involved in criminal activity when he joined the gangster [[Lazlo]]'s gang. After Lazlo's death, Bane grew in infamy after he killed both a [[Unidentified marshal|marshal]] and his former friend [[Niro]] as revenge, eventually becoming a bounty hunter. After the unceremonious [[Death|demise]] of [[Jango Fett]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis|Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY]], Bane was considered the best and one of the most experienced bounty hunters of the era. Although his infamy grew during the [[Clone Wars]] in particular, Bane had a high standing both within the underworld and amongst other bounty hunters, working with the likes of [[Aurra Sing]] years before the onset of the war. He even ran a temporary contract for the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth]] [[Maul]]. Bane specialized in fighting [[Jedi]] and dueled with some of the most skilled Jedi during the Clone Wars, including [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]]. His reputation led him to be repeatedly employed by the Sith Lord [[Darth Sidious]], working for him on numerous projects, including [[Raid on the Jedi Temple|infiltrating]] the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] to steal a [[kyber memory crystal]] containing a list of [[Force-sensitive]] children throughout the galaxy. Bane was later hired by the [[gangster]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]] to free Jabba's uncle, [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], out of Republic prison. After a successful mission, Bane was re-hired to track down Ziro when he fled. Bane found Ziro dead on [[Teth]] and eventually dueled Kenobi and [[Quinlan Vos]], using a variety of weapons to hold his own against the two Jedi before fleeing. Later into the war, Bane was brought in by Darth Sidious' then-[[Sith apprentice]], [[Count]] [[Dooku]], to participate in the [[Box]], surviving the deadly challenges before being appointed the overseer of the plot to kidnap the [[Supreme Chancellor]]. However, their plans were foiled when it was revealed that Kenobi had infiltrated their ranks, disguised as bounty hunter [[Rako Hardeen]], and Bane was arrested along with the rest of the group. Bane was still active during the early reign of the [[Galactic Empire]]. At this time, he was hired by [[Kaminoan]] [[Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su]] to retrieve an unaltered female [[Cloning|clone]] named [[Omega]] and although he initially accomplished his task, he was ultimately thwarted by the intervention of both fellow hunter [[Fennec Shand]] and [[Clone Force 99]]. Nonetheless, he continued to provide his services to the highest bidder after the [[Battle of Jakku|fall]] of the Galactic Empire and the rise of the [[New Republic]]. By [[9 ABY]], Bane was working for the [[Pyke Syndicate]] on [[Tatooine]], assisting the nefarious cartel in their expansion of the [[spice]] trade onto the planet. After a confrontation with his old apprentice, [[Boba Fett]], he was defeated and stabbed through the chest in the streets of [[Mos Espa]], killing him. ==Biography== ===Early life=== ====The good life==== {{Quote|Good news, bad news, kid. Bad news is your friend got caught. Good news is you get his share. Welcome to the family.|Lazlo, to Colby|}} [[File:TheGoodLife-EpisodeThumb.png|thumb|245px|left|Colby and Niro on the streets as orphans.]] A [[Gender|male]] [[Duros]], [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Duro]] around [[62 BBY]], Colby was brought up as an orphan alongside his friend [[Niro]] on the streets of a [[Unidentified city (Cad Bane)|crime ridden city]]. One day, Colby and Niro ran amok, eyeing [[Foodstuff|food]] through the windows of local businesses and sifting through trash cans. The two boys were then approached by [[Blik]], another [[youngling]], but Blik was admonished by his [[Blik's mother|mother]] for associating with them. Peering through another [[The Corner Shop|shop]] window, Colby and Niro were shooed away by the store's [[Aqualish]] [[Unidentified Aqualish shopkeeper|owner]], causing them to run down an adjacent alley. Finding food among the garbage, Niro and Colby celebrated, only to be interrupted by a debtor being ejected from the store's backroom [[casino]]. Knocking over a bottle, Niro caught the casino [[Unidentified kingpin|owner]]'s attention, who told the boys to leave. The younglings scurried away but caught the eye of the outlaw [[Lazlo]]. Rummaging through trash with Niro, Colby expressed a desire for [[crunchies]]. Noticing the [[RA-7 protocol droid]] [[CB]], a previous mark who carried a container of food, the pair exchanged a glance and ran across the street. As Niro distracted the [[droid]], Colby bumped into CB, spilling his bag. Observed by Lazlo, the [[Duro]]s performed a routine, pretending to assist CB while in actuality confusing him and relieving him of his belongings. The younglings quickly ran away into an alley. While enjoying their ill-gotten gains, Colby and Niro were approached by Lazlo, who congratulated them on their con. Reassuring them that he was not a [[security officer]], he tossed Niro a [[coin]], introducing himself as a businessman. As Colby swiped the coin, Niro questioned the reward, which Lazlo clarified was an investment before departing. Later, Colby and Niro snatched the coin from one another as they walked the streets, contemplating its worth. Arriving at the Aqualish's store, Colby suggested spending it. As the boys admired toys and colorful dispensers, considering what to purchase, a patron entered the shop, going into the casino, welcomed by the owner. Colby led Niro to dispensers full of crunchies, which the younglings brought before the clerk. When the boys presented their coin, the Aqualish accused them of stealing it, but Colby said they earned it. Placing the coin in his mouth, the Aqualish examined it; it glistened. The Aqualish accepted the purchase, leaving Cobly and Niro to go on their way with the [[candy]]. On a rooftop, Colby and Niro ate the last of their crunchies. Reminded of his mother, Colby thought of his parents, who he told Niro he never knew and did not miss. Altered by sirens to a [[Law enforcement agency|police]] chase, the boys raced across the rooftop, watching in awe. The next morning, Lazlo nudged the sleeping Duros, having come to collect on his investment. Commenting on their taste of "the good life," he offered the prospect of more, leaving the boys to scamper after him as he walked away. On the street, the younglings noticed Lazlo's limp, though the [[gangster]] told Niro to not ask questions. When Niro talked back to Lazlo for asking if they knew the Aqualish's store, Lazlo told Niro not to get smart. Colby told Lazlo that the owner did not like them, who responded that he did not like the Aqualish either, as the store ran an operation that interfered with his business. Offering the boys the opportunity to make five times what he had given them before, Lazlo claimed the task was simple. Hesitant, Niro took Colby aside, finding Lazlo's appearance and the circumstances of the offer to be suspect. Colby agreed that the job was not worth it—demanding ten times the original payment from Lazlo, who smiled. After dark, Colby and Niro trashed an alley, getting the attention of the casino owner and his [[Imperial Police Droid|security droids]]. As they did so, Lazlo's gang [[Raid on The Corner Shop|broke into]] and shot up the shop, stealing a bag of coins. The casino owner chased Colby and Niro, but was shot by Lazlo, who encouraged the boys to run. The younglings stared at the body until Colby shook Niro. The Duros ran behind Lazlo as police [[speeder]]s pulled up to the scene, impeding the boys' escape. Colby slid over the speeder directly in front of him, but Niro was caught by a [[Unidentified police droid model|police droid]]. Lazlo ushered Colby into a speeder along with his gang, escaping law enforcement. In the speeder, Lazlo told Colby that although Niro had been caught, Colby would receive his friend's cut of the pay. Dumping a pile of coins into the hands of the young Duros, Lazlo welcomed him to the family as Colby stared at the cash before him. ====A good turn==== {{Quote|This revenge. I hope it was worth it.''"
"''It will be.|Niro and Cad Bane|}} Years later, Colby, now going by the name Cad Bane had become a member of [[Cad Bane's gang|Lazlo's gang]] who operated on Duro and had begun a relationship with his fellow Duros gang member [[Arin]]. When Lazlo prepared for an operation in his former neighborhood, Bane grabbed a [[blaster]], but Lazlo ordered him to remain behind and watch over the gang's hangar bay instead to not make the matter personal, instructing Arin to keep an [[eye]] on him. The two sat and played [[cards]] until Lazlo's transport returned early, crashing to a halt before the unflinching Bane. Rushing inside, Bane asked [[Unidentified Bith (Cad Bane)|the pilot]] what had happened and where Lazlo was. The pilot replied that Lazlo had been [[Death|killed]] by a lawman. As the [[Unidentified Bith (Cad Bane)|Bith]] collapsed, Lazlo's hat rolled to the ground. Picking up the [[hat]], Bane wondered aloud who was responsible. Returning to Duro, Bane and Arin traveled to Bane's neighborhood. Bane stopped at the candy store he frequented as a youngling. No longer open, he stared through its windows. Encountering Niro, Bane embraced his old friend. Arin referred to Colby as Cad, a name unfamiliar to Niro; Bane and Niro agreed that a lot had changed. Bane alluded to his quest for vengeance against Lazlo's killer, causing Niro to tell his former friend that he had best not cause trouble; Niro was now a deputy, which Bane coldly remarked was "fancy." Bane asked if Niro had killed Lazlo, but Niro told Bane that Lazlo's death was [[Unidentified marshal|the marshal]]'s doing, who he insisted would pay. Niro suggested Bane leave, and Arin led him away. Aboard Lazlo's ship, Arin tried asking Bane to drop the vendetta. Bane refused, telling Arin to leave if she wanted to. Arin expressed a fear of losing him, saying that more was at stake than he knew, but Bane donned Lazlo's hat and left. At the candy store, Bane considered his childhood self, reflected in the shop window, before shooting it and tossing a [[detonator]]. The attack was reported by [[security droid]]s to Niro and the marshal, the latter of whom arrived to confront the perpetrator. Bane introduced himself, and both he and the marshal reached for the [[blaster]] at their side, initiating a tense [[Showdown in an unidentified city|stand-off]]. Abruptly, Niro called out to Colby, distracting the marshal. Drawing, the men fired and dodging his adversary's blaster bolt, Bane shot the marshal, turning to realize that his opponent had inadvertently hit Arin in the shoulder. Bane grabbed Arin to run, but Arin collapsed, and Bane stayed at her side. Arin once again urged Bane to let go, but he said that he could not. Niro seized the marshal's blaster and, as [[police speeder]]s arrived at the scene, warned Bane that there was no escape. Arin told Bane that they had a future, which Bane promised to ensure. As Niro prepared to duel Bane, Arin pleaded with him not to and tossed Niro Bane's blaster, an act Bane registered as betrayal. Surrounded by four police droids, Bane was restrained and, as he was escorted away to be arrested, Niro asked if Bane's revenge was worth it; Bane replied that it would be. ====One good deed==== {{Quote|You took everything from me.''"
"''Not everything.|Cad Bane and Niro|}} [[File:CadBane-OneGoodDeed.png|thumb|right|255px|Cad Bane confronts Niro.]] Bane was [[Prison|imprisoned]] on [[Torano]]. After a few years, he was later released early on a technicality, causing officials of his old city to become fearful of retribution. When members of Lazlo's gang appeared at a [[Unidentified spaceport (Cad Bane)|local spaceport]], Niro and his deputy [[Vance]] determined that Bane was aboard an inbound transport arriving at noon, though Niro refrained from taking any preemptive action. Then Bane and his crew went to confront Niro. During that time, Niro tried to send his adopted son [[Isaac]] away. Bane confronted him, despite Niro having several droids with blasters. Bane's team died in the struggle to take down all of the droid guards with them. Bane then [[Second showdown in an unidentified city|confronted]] Niro while Isaac was still with him and shot Niro twice through the chest. Realizing what he had meant that there was a secret left to be revealed, Bane tried to comfort Isaac before being pushed away by [[Unidentified mayor|the mayor]], who took care of Isaac. ===The Jedi, the Sith, and the Duros=== {{Quote|I have a bad feeling about this, Bane. Our employer seems capable enough. Why does he need us?''"
"''Hold onto those suspicions, Aurra. They're ''healthy''. They'll keep us ''alive''. I've been thinking our friend might have hired us as ''patsies'' more than ''allies''. But that doesn't mean we won't get rich in the process. There's a lot of money floating around that space station.|Aurra Sing and Cad Bane|}} [[File:MaulMeetsBane-2017DarthMaul2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bane meets with Darth Maul.]] Cad Bane eventually became a [[bounty hunter]]. During the early stages of his career, Bane was briefly mentored by fellow bounty hunter [[Jango Fett]]. He came to owe Fett several favors as well, but he never ended up paying them back.{{StoryCite|story=Bane's Story|book=The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark}} In [[time]], Bane himself would gain a reputation as a famous [[bounty]] hunter.[[Age of Republic - Jango Fett 1|''Age of Republic - Jango Fett'' 1]] Bane was once involved in an embarrassing incident on the planet''[[The High Republic: Midnight Horizon]]'' [[Corellia]]. He had encounters with the [[Jedi]] that left him with the belief they always offered a fair fight. At some point prior to the [[Battle of Naboo|Battle]] of [[Naboo]], Cad Bane was contracted by the [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul|Darth Maul]] and met with him on [[Nar Shaddaa]]. He, along with fellow bounty hunters [[Aurra Sing]], [[Troo-tril-tek]], and [[Vorhdeilo]] assisted Maul in acquiring [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Eldra Kaitis]] from [[Xev Xrexus]]' [[Auction of Eldra Kaitis|auction]]. During the auction, Bane and Vorhdeilo [[Death|killed]] several of [[Jee Kra]]'s crew aboard his [[Shekelesh-class freight gunship|''Shekelesh''-class freight gunship]]. Bane, along with Maul, Sing and Vorhdeilo then met up with Kra and Kaitis at Kra's [[gunship]]. Bane [[pilot]]ed the stolen [[Starship|ship]] after Maul subdued the [[Moogan]] thugs. Uneasy with their mysterious employer, Bane and Sing then discussed potentially killing Maul.[[Darth Maul (2017) 3|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 3]] However, their ship was sabotaged, and they were forced to crash-land on the [[Moon of Drazkel]]. Bane along with Maul, Kaitis, Sing, and Vorhdeilo survived the crash. The Duros bounty hunter then concluded that Xrexus was making a sport and profit out of them, by giving each of the parties that attended the auction the chance to track them down and claim the Jedi Padawan for themselves. As Maul took Kaitis with him, Bane, Sing and Vorhdeilo prepared to fight Xrexus' clients. Bane fought several [[Trandoshan]]s alongside Vorhdeilo and Sing.[[Darth Maul (2017) 4|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 4]] The three bounty hunters then stole a ship from the [[Ohnaka Gang]] after he took the last of the Trandoshans. Bane and the others picked up Maul and left him to take out Xrexus at [[Xev's hideout|her hideout]].[[Darth Maul (2017) 5|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 5]] ===The Clone Wars=== ====Hunter amid war==== {{Quote|Cad Bane, who needs no introduction.|Count Dooku, introducing Bane|{{TCW|The Box}}}} Prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars]], Jango Fett's [[Cloning|clone]] [[Reproduction|son]], [[Boba Fett]], had learned of Bane. During the conflict, Bane became one of the main bounty hunters of the era after the demise of Jango on [[Geonosis]]. Subsequently, he found himself hired by many of [[the galaxy]]'s highest bidders, including the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]{{TCW|Deception}} and the [[Hutt Clan]]. Bane also acquired the [[Techno-service droid]] [[Todo 360]],, who carried out his whims faithfully in spite of his mistreatment. Over the course of the war, he would kill many of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[clone trooper]]s, teaching him how to defeat them, a fact which he would eventually brag about.{{TBB|Reunion}} However, he believed the [[Jedi Order]] had changed as the war continued, saying that they no longer offered the fair fights he once associated them with. ====Heist at the Jedi Temple==== {{Quote|Excuse the interruption. As I was saying, bounty hunter, I have need of your services.''"
"''I'm listening.|Darth Sidious and Cad Bane|}} [[File:Cad_Bade_Holocron_FF.png|thumb|243px|Bane holds the stolen holocron.]] During the War, the [[Sith]] Lord [[Darth Sidious]] reached out to Bane, whom he needed to [[Raid on the Jedi Temple|obtain]] a [[holocron]] from the [[Holocron Vault]] in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]]. Initially hesitant at the risks of the operation, the bounty hunter was eventually persuaded to accept when the Sith Lord implied rumors of his talents may have been "exaggerated". Sidious provided Bane with a map of the [[Jedi temple]] and a security chip containing the temple's security systems. Bane installed the chip into Todo, in addition to a bomb unbeknownst to the latter, and also subcontracted a fellow bounty hunter, the [[Clawdite]] [[Cato Parasitti]], to aid him from inside the temple by posing as the deceased Jedi [[Ord Enisence]]. With his plan set, Bane and his accomplices proceeded to the Jedi Temple and set their plan into motion. Bane and Todo used their [[rocket boot]]s to reach an unattended overhang on the side of the Jedi Temple, close to the building's roof. With Parasitti at a [[computer]] terminal in the Archive Library, Todo was able to locate a weak point in the Temple's [[Deflector shield|energy shield]] and opened up an aperture in the shield with a touch of his finger. Bane and his droid zoomed in through the breach and found the Holocron Vaults. While Bane used his gauntlet to cut through the safe's lock mechanism, Todo deactivated the remainder of the laser beams surrounding the vault's entrance before slice through the wall and cut a passage to the Temple's [[Jedi Temple communication center|communication center]] on Bane's orders. When he lost contact with Parasitti as her cover had been blown by [[Ahsoka Tano]], Bane was unable to access the diagrams that would help him deactivate the lock. After ordering Todo to go to the communication center, Bane primed a bomb to break through the vault's lock. The hunter hid from the approaching jedi [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and waited until the pair had followed Todo to the communication center before emerging from the shadows. Bane heaved the Holocron Vaults' door open all the way and proceeded unopposed into the room, where he extracted the holocron from its holding place. With Todo exploding from the bomb implanted on him by Bane and Parasatti being apprehended by the [[Jedi Council]], Bane successfully escaped the temple, unnoticed with the holocron. ====Skirmish over Devaron==== {{Quote|What do you want?''"
"''This holocron contains information I've been paid to collect. I can't unlock it, but ''you'' can. The last Jedi who had it wouldn't open it. I hope ''you'' don't make the same mistake.|Anakin Skywalker and Cad Bane|{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}}} [[File:Cad-Bane-clonetrooper-SWCT.png|thumb|left|155px|Bane, disguised as a clone trooper.]] Cad Bane escaped Coruscant with the stolen [[Jedi holocron|holocron]]. [[Darth]] Sidious asked [[Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] loan him a small [[fleet]] of [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] to help Bane carry out his next assignment: to kidnap [[Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal]] and have him combine the holocron and the [[Kyber memory crystal]], which was held by the [[Rodian]]. Bane initiated a ground attack on the surface of [[Devaron]] and captured both Ropal and the [[kyber crystal]]. However, a [[Republic Navy|fleet]] of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|Republic ships]], led by [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], came to Devaron, and in the ensuing [[Battle of Devaron|battle]], most [[frigate]]s were destroyed, leaving only the [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate|vessel]] with Bane and Ropal on board. Skywalker had his fleet destroy the [[hyperdrive]] of the Separatist flagship, preventing him from going into [[hyperspace]]. Bane then attempted to force Ropal to open it by [[Torture|torturing]] him. However, Ropal died due to the unbearable torture before he could open the holocron. To the exasperated Gunray's relief, Bane then came up with a plan to force Skywalker and [[Ahsoka Tano|his apprentice]] to open the holocron. Bane arranged an ambush on the gun deck for Skywalker, Tano, [[Rex]], and their [[501st Legion|troops]]. At first Bane and the [[droid]]s placed at his disposal had the upper hand in the ambush. However, Bane almost lost the [[crystal]] to Skywalker. When the [[gravity]] came back on, Bane retrieved the crystal and was able to lure Skywalker's apprentice away from the gunfight. Bane subdued Tano, took a piece of her [[Padawan braid]], and placed her in front of an [[airlock]]. Bane was then confronted by Skywalker, who demanded his surrender. However, Bane threatened to kill Tano if Skywalker refused to combine the holocron and memory crystal. Skywalker thus complied. Bane was successful and made his escape when he opened the airlock. Bane was then contacted by Gunray, who wanted Bane to transmit the crystal's information in exchange for his rescue. However, the wary Bane refused, preferring to plan his own escape. Bane was then confronted by two clone troopers, [[Denal]] and [[Koho]]. At first, Skywalker and the others saw that Denal shot Bane dead, but did not have time to retrieve the holocron. However, the Jedi Knight could sense the bounty hunter, who faked his death and took his victim's [[Clone trooper armor|armor]]. One of the [[trooper]]s and Tano discovered his ruse when they found his [[blood]], which had come from an injury he sustained during his fight with Denal, and saw that he was not a clone. Bane then knocked Tano out and stole a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter]], before fleeing to [[Black Stall Station]].{{TCW|Children of the Force}} ====Kidnapping Force-sensitive children==== {{Quote|Kidnapping innocent children? Seems like a small-time crime for the likes of you.|Cad Bane, to Darth Sidious|}} [[File:CadBane-SWZ92.png|thumb|right|250px|Bane pilots ''Xanadu Blood'' away from Rodia]] After obtaining the holocron from the Jedi Temple, Darth Sidious tasked Cad Bane with kidnapping four [[Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling|children]] for a [[Project Harvester|secret project]] on [[Mustafar]]. After the bounty hunter got away the [[Rodian]] child [[Wee Dunn]] from [[Rodia]] and the [[Nautolan]] child [[Zinn Toa]] from [[Glee Anselm]], Skywalker and Tano arrested him as he [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page|attempted]] to retrieve [[Roo-Roo Page]] from [[Jan-gwa city]] on [[Naboo]]. The two Jedi, along with Masters [[Mace Windu]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], attempted to interrogate the captive Bane, with little success aboard the ''[[Resolute]]'', reaching the conclusion that the latter probably dreaded his employer than he feared them. Apparently yielding to the torturous mind-probing, Bane relented to [[Mission to Black Stall Station|taking]] Windu, Kenobi, and [[Cody]] to the [[space station]], where he claimed that both the children and the holocron were; only the holocron was present. However, the bounty hunter was able to have the Jedi trigger a trap and made his escape. ====Senate hostage crisis==== {{Quote|I'm in control. I make the rules now.|Cad Bane, to Supreme Chancellor Palpatine|audio=CadBaneInControl.flac|{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}}} By the time of his future endeavors, Bane had had Todo 360 rebuilt. Bane was later hired by [[Daimyo]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]] to free his captive uncle, [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure|Ziro]], from the [[Galactic Republic|Republic's]] [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center|high-security prison]] on Coruscant. The bounty hunter started by having his sidekick and [[HELIOS-3E]] kidnap [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]'s [[protocol droid]], [[C-3PO]], and Skywalker's [[Astromech droid|astromech]], [[R2-D2]], in order to get blueprints for the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]]. After retrieving the knowledge, Bane had the two droids' [[Memory wipe|memories erased]] and returned to ensure his plans would not be discovered. Bane subsequently traveled to [[Tatooine]], where both Jabba and the rest of the [[Grand Hutt Council|Hutt Council]] agreed that Bane would be the one to free Ziro before he could expose the [[Hutt Council records]] to the [[Galactic Senate]]. Bane, along with a team of other bounty hunters that included Aurra Sing, [[Shahan Alama]], [[Robonino]], [[HELIOS-3D]], HELIOS-3E, a pair of [[BX-series droid commando|droid commandos]], and [[Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid (Cad Bane)|another]] [[IG-86 sentinel droid]], then made their way to the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]]. As Bane distracted the [[Senate Guard]]s, Sing and the rest of the team took them out, with the Duros strangling the last one. As the two [[commando]] droids posed as Senate Guards in their requisitioned uniforms, the bounty hunter and his team went inside. There, Bane was able to kill the remaining Senate Guards as they went to speak with the senators, before hesitantly leaving Robonino to turn the power off. [[File:Hostage-Crisis-old-thumbnail.png|thumb|left|270px|Cad Bane with Aurra Sing and the IG-86 sentinel droid.]] Bane found a group of senators that were discussing the [[Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill]]. At first, the unintimidated Senator [[Philo]] refused to cooperate with Bane and his team. To scare the former's colleagues into submission, the Duros shot the [[Gran]] representative in the back and had his team threaten the other senators. Bane then contacted [[Supreme Chancellor|Chancellor]] Palpatine - the public alter ego of Darth Sidious - and demanded a pardon disk for Ziro. But not that tired.|Cad Bane, to Gardulla the Hutt|}} [[File:CadBaneRocketFlamethrower-HFZ.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Bane fought the Jedi on Teth during the hunt for Ziro.]] The bounty hunter once again lent his talents to the Hutt crime families after Ziro escaped his prison on [[Nal Hutta]] with the help of singer [[Sy Snootles]]. After a brief [[Showdown on Teth|battle]] against the two Jedi which required all of his skills and tech, Bane once again evaded capture. ===Count Dooku's plan=== ====Prison break on Coruscant==== {{Quote|It's not the first time I've broken out of this stinkhole.|Cad Bane to [[Moralo Eval]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi|Rako Hardeen]]|}} At a certain point during the war, Bane was apprehended by the Republic for his crimes and imprisoned in the Central Detention Center. He had been hired by [[Moralo Eval]], a criminal mastermind working for Darth Sidious' right-hand, [[Count]] [[Dooku]], to break him out of prison. Eval had Hardeen brought to his own cell to talk with him and introduced him to Bane, who had taken an immediate strong dislike of Hardeen and was definitely not in for breaking the latter out as well, so Eval had Hardeen brought back to his cell. Neither Bane nor Eval knew that Hardeen was in fact Kenobi in disguise, only there to learn about Dooku's plan. [[File:TheGreatEscape-D.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Cad Bane, Obi-Wan Kenobi (disguised as Rako Hardeen) and [[Moralo Eval]] in the prison hallways.]] Promising them some of his payment, Bane persuaded two fellow bounty hunters imprisoned in the facility, Jango's son Boba Fett and the [[Trandoshan]] [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk]], to start a [[Riot at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center|riot]] as a diversion for him and Eval to escape. The young boy was successful, and the two plotters escaped in the ensuing chaos. Hardeen followed them into the hallways, and although Bane was against it, he reluctantly let Hardeen come along, as Eval thought he might be of use. Bane's plan was to escape the facility via the mortuary, but the lock of the mortuary doors had been changed and Bane was unable to open them. Hardeen told his comrades to stand guard while he figured it out and secretly [[Telekinesis|used]] [[the Force]] to open the lock. The three quickly climbed into the coffins meant to send the victims of the riot to the cremation center. The [[Cloning|clones]] in the cremation center found out that the people in the coffins were still alive. The trio quickly climbed out of the coffins. One of the clones tried to shoot Bane, who used another clone to shield himself from the blast, before disarming and killing the clone that shot with his own gun. Hardeen disarmed the third clone, but hesitated to kill him. The clone triggered the alarm before Bane executed him. The Duros angrily asked the sniper why he did not take the shot, and the latter claimed that his [[blaster]] jammed. The trio made their way to a landing platform, the veteran bounty hunter shooting more guards in the process. They stole a [[Panther police interceptor|police speeder]] and used it to fly to the docks, where they stole a cargo ship from a [[Quarren]] pilot, which they used to escape Coruscant. Once in the air Bane hit Hardeen in the face for hesitating to shoot the clone in the cremation center. Eval, however, was most pleased that Hardeen had come along and considered involving him again. ====Trouble on Nal Hutta==== {{Quote|Relax. On this slime pool, everybody's an outlaw.| Cad Bane, to his comrades while on Nal Hutta|{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}}} Following their escape from Coruscant, Bane, Hardeen, and Eval crashed their ship in the [[swamp]]s of [[Nal Hutta]]. The bounty hunter then decided to turn Hardeen over to [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder|Gardulla]] and her guards due to his mistrust of him. However, as Eval and Bane left, they were shot down by the guards' [[HH-87 Starhopper]]s. They then left the ship only to find Hardeen having a drink at the [[Bilbousa saloon|saloon]]. There, Bane and Eval were surprised to learn that he acquired another ship for them. ====Tournament on Serenno==== {{Quote|If you're gonna kill him, do it like a man.|Cad Bane, to Moralo Eval, after saving Rako Hardeen|}} [[File:EnterIfYouDare-TB.jpg|thumb|left|308x308px|Cad Bane and the other contestants prepare to enter "The Box".]] The trio made it to [[Serenno]], where they met the Count. The two reluctantly accepted with the Duros suspecting that it would be a deadly contest and that not all participants would survive. Bane then spotted the [[Fedora|hat]] of fellow contestant [[Bulduga]], noticing it resembled his old hat and deciding it was better than the hat he got on Nal Hutta. He asked the bounty hunter how he got it. Bulduga responded by drawing his [[blaster pistol]], but the Duros was faster and shot the [[Ithorian]] in the chest, killing him in front of his brother [[Onca]]. They were then escorted to an [[Turbolift|elevator]] that led into The Box, and the tournament started. [[File:EnterTheBox-TB.png|right|thumb|311x311px|Bane and the others await the first challenge.]] The contestants found themselves in a room, and Eval appeared on a screen to mention that the only rule during the contest was that there were no rules. When the platforms started to rise too much towards the ceiling the group found themselves between getting crushed by the ceiling and a layer of dioxis below them. Hardeen deduced that the way out of the room was not in the ceiling but was somewhere in the floor. Hardeen found out that there was a hole in the floor that led to a tunnel below the gas line and to another room. Bane and the others followed Hardeen's example and survived the first test without casualties. The tunnel led to a second room where Eval appeared on screen again and commented that the second test unlike the first would result in some casualties. Suddenly columns with electrified blades started to shove in and out the walls. Onca and Swan ended up impaled on the blades, and Sinrich was killed by Embo. Hardeen discovered a pattern in the way the columns shoved in and out and noticed it led to a hole in the ceiling of the room. He showed his discovery to Bane, who told him to go to the hole. Bane and the others followed Hardeen in his climb and made it to the shaft in the ceiling that led to a third room. [[File:Task3RayShields-TB.png|left|thumb|308x308px|The group during the third challenge.]] In the next room, the group once again received instructions from Eval, who told them to pass through his [[ray shield]] to switch it off with a button that was positioned behind the shield. It was, however, toxic to all but one of them. The ray shield appeared and started to close in on the group. After a while the floor became ray shielded as well, killing Jakoli and forcing the rest on a platform in the center of the room. When Derrown wanted to take the serum, Bane protested, but Hardeen told him to let Derrown take the serum as he was a [[Parwan]] and his blood could take the serum. When the ray shield closed in more and more, the platform became smaller and smaller, and Mantu was killed by the shield. Derrown was, however, able to inject the serum into his blood, pass through the shield and successfully deactivate the shield in time, allowing the remaining contestants to proceed to the fourth and final challenge. In the fourth room, the group was positioned on a platform above a [[Fire|fiery]] pit. Eval appeared and informed them that this test was about sharpshooter skills. One of them had to hit a target that moved very fast across the back wall with a [[sniper rifle]]. Sixtat volunteered and hit the target twice. His third shot missed, however, and as a result he fell into the flames. Hardeen then took the [[sniper]] rifle and made an attempt as well, successfully hitting the target three times. Although Hardeen completed the task, Eval moved the platform to separate Hardeen from the others. Dooku had noticed that Hardeen had been the cause of success on every test and planned on putting Hardeen in charge of the mission rather than Eval. Eval wanted Hardeen to hit some more targets. Hardeen hit another four, but then the rifle was empty and Eval saw his chance to get rid of him. When he tried drop Hardeen in the flames, Bane used his [[Whipcord launcher|whipcord]] to prevent Hardeen from falling. Eval was angry with this, but Bane told him that if he wanted to kill Hardeen he should do it like a man in a [[Unarmed combat|fair fight]]. Dooku agreed and dropped Eval in the room to fight Hardeen face to face. Eval didn't play fair and used his remote control to activate a few traps in the room and sent in some [[probe droid]]s to kill Hardeen. Nevertheless, Hardeen defeated Eval eventually, and Dooku ordered Hardeen to finish Eval off. Hardeen, being a Jedi in disguise, refused to kill Eval, to Dooku's disappointment. Dooku, however, congratulated the remaining bounty hunters for surviving the Box and announced that the job was in fact to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine during the upcoming [[Festival of Light]] on Naboo. He also announced that Bane would lead the [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine|mission]]. ====Kidnapping the Supreme Chancellor==== {{Quote|Kenobi! I should have known. Both Bane and Hunter drew their blasters, though Bane's tenure as a seasoned mercenary had bestowed the Duros with a superior quick-draw. Hunter was subsequently blasted in the chest, allowing Bane to kidnap Omega after stunning her. ====Showdown on Bora Vio==== {{Quote|By hook or by crook…you're coming with me.|Cad Bane, to Omega|}} [[File:BountyLost.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Bane and Todo 360 onboard the ''Justifier''.]] Onboard his ship, the ''[[Justifier]]'', Bane contacted his Kaminoan employers, whom he told to bring his payment to their arranged rendezvous, which was at an abandoned [[Bora Vio cloning facility|facility]] on [[Bora Vio]]. After turning his droid back on, he eventually tracked the girl down and destroyed her comm device that she had reclaimed from his hold. Then, he found the Kaminoan representative, [[Taun We]], dead, and discovered that the young bounty hunter [[Fennec Shand]] had killed her and taken his case of credits. Shand suggested that they swap the payment and Omega, to which Bane agreed, but Todo sneaked up from behind and seized the credits from her. A shootout ensued between them, during which Shand kicked a [[Thermal detonator|detonator]] thrown by Bane at Todo, causing him to drop the credits off the edge of the facility. Omega fled while Bane fought Shand. [[File:BaneFlamethrowers-BL.png|thumb|left|250px|Bane attempts to burn Shand with his dual flamethrowers.]] After a short battle, Shand slipped away and Bane cautiously searched for her. He again tried to pursue Omega, only to be attacked from behind by Shand. As he watched Shand fly off in her ship, the ''[[Outcast]]'', Bane snarled with rage as he was unable to take off. ====A familiar quarry==== {{Quote|How many others like this have you captured?''"

As Boba walked off from his former mentor, Bane's suit slowly beeped on his corpse as a light flashed. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|Next you're going to tell me that you weren't planning to mention Captain Rex, Ahsoka, Ventress, Cad Bane, Savage Opress, Jar Jar, and the Mandalorians?"

As long as I get paid, it makes no difference to me.|Cad Bane, to Darth Sidious|audio=AsLongAsIGetPaid-CotF.flac|}} [[File:Gist-CW15Years-CadBane.png|thumb|left|200px|Cad Bane was known to wear a hat, a fashion choice paired with a long coat and a habit to chew a toothpick.]] As a [[Duros]], Cad Bane had red eyes and blue skin, standing 1.85 [[meter]]s and weighing 75 [[kilogram]]s. Bane became one of the best bounty hunters in the galaxy''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' following Jango Fett's demise.''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' Cold, cruel, and capable in his line of work, Bane cared little for the sinister motives of his employers such as Darth Sidious, the [[Pyke Syndicate|Pykes]], and [[Galactic Empire]] and the Hutts. Despite the fact that his new pupil was descended from his old mentor Jango, Bane did not take any liking to Boba and was very abusive when he trained him, which made Fett remember his harsh adolescence on his part and that he had no mercy in killing his former mentor. Bane told Fett to only look out for yourself and that anything else was a liability. Bane was a very cunning individual, and he often proved capable of outsmarting others such as Jedi and other criminals. He showed impressive strategic ability and was more than capable of leading a team effort despite his preference for working alone. Bane's accomplishments during the Clone Wars meant he had a detailed file in the Republic's records. [[File:CadBane-BHUSC.png|thumb|right|220px|Bane remained ruthless throughout his career.]] Bane had something of a quirk when it came to wide brim hats, which he heavily preferred wearing. This desire was such he was willing to kill [[Bulduga|another bounty hunter]] simply because he had a hat he liked. He also had a habit of chewing on toothpicks. Additionally, the hunter spoke down to those younger than him, using terms like "son" and "little lady" when he felt they fit. In spite of his ruthlessness, he did apologize to Omega before he stunned her, yet he continued with his mission nevertheless. He also saved Obi-Wan Kenobi (in disguise as Rako Hardeen) from falling to his death into the fire. ===Mentor to Boba Fett=== {{Quote|Consider this my final lesson. Look out for yourself. Anything else is weakness.|Cad Bane, to Boba Fett|}} Bane once reflected to himself that the young Boba Fett sometimes reminded him of his younger self, but their relationship eventually soured. As his age passed, Bane remained bitter and ruthless, killing any who stood in his way. He tried to strike down his former ward Boba Fett, without mercy or discrimination. Bane looked at Fett with contempt for what happened between them, determined to kill him even if he played dirty. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|You lack the experience to be goin' up against me.|Bane to Fennec Shand|}} [[File:BaneBlastersBoraVio-BL.png|thumb|left|250px|Bane was an extremely skilled gunslinger.]] Bane was a skilled bounty hunter, relying on various weapons as well as his wits to defeat enemies. Bane was a master marksman, utilizing twin blasters as his preferred weapons. He was so skilled that he beat Hunter in a duel and countless others, and had a quick draw he retained into his seventies. He also proved to be more skilled than Boba Fett, outdrawing him even though Fett had his [[EE-3 carbine rifle]] in his hand, while Bane's gun was still in its [[holster]]. He was fairly proficient in [[unarmed combat]], holding his own in a fight with Fennec Shand. He was noted for his ability to combat members of the Jedi Order, which was a necessary skill during the Clone Wars. The combination of his rocket boots, weapons such as flamethrowers, and knowing when he was outmatched proved useful in his numerous encounters with Jedi Knights. When he temporarily had [[Quinlan Vos's lightsaber|Vos's lightsaber]], he managed to hold against Kenobi in [[lightsaber combat]], until he was disarmed after a few strikes. His work earned the respect of his enemies, such as the Jedi, as well as potential employers, such as Count Dooku. Bane was even trusted by Darth Sidious himself. Into the Imperial era, Bane operated as a class one bounty hunter and was entrusted to track down targets for a secret Imperial project overseen by the [[Advanced Science Division]], a project that the Emperor himself regarded as of utmost importance.{{TBB|Shadows of Tantiss}} He also was a very skilled pilot, and flew the ''[[Xanadu Blood]]'' during the Clone Wars, and after the war's end, piloted the ''[[Justifier]]''. Bane proved himself a competent leader and tactician, leading several different groups of bounty hunters on multiple occasions. He felt that all clone troopers fought the same and was confident using similar methods on the Republic soldiers. At an advanced age, Bane was still extremely skilled and fast. Bane bested both Cobb Vanth and Boba Fett in their duels on Tatooine by drawing his blaster faster, having been killed only because he was surprised by Fett when he approached to kill his former student. He was also flexible enough to dodge Boba's flamethrowers. ==Equipment== [[File:BaneFlamethrower-BL.png|thumb|right|300px|Each of Bane's gauntlets was equipped with a flamethrower.]] In his youth, Bane carried a blaster pistol with a scope mounted on the side. Arin secretly snatched it from Bane after he killed the marshal. Cad Bane was known for wielding a pair of [[LL-30 blaster pistol]]s''[[Star Wars: Galactic Defense]]'' and wearing his trademark wide-brimmed hat. He wore [[Electro Gauntlet|electro gauntlets]]{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2020/2/11/special-agents|text=Special Agents}} with flamethrowers and a [[wrist comm]] to communicate with others. His gauntlets were also capable of remote control and could operate many starship functions after all of a ship's primary functions were transferred into them. His [[glove]]s were equipped with [[stunner]]s. Bane also carried [[bola]]s and a [[hypnogazer]] within his [[greatcoat]]. Bane also wore a pair of [[rocket boot]]s and made use of them on many occasions. His boots were also equipped with magnets, which he used to stay grounded after deactivating the [[artificial gravity]] aboard the [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] he had been lent by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|the Separatists]]. Bane used another piece of equipment that served his specialty capturing in Jedi, [[stuncuffs]]. Bane used these stuncuffs, which electrocuted the victim if they struggled, to bind Ahsoka Tano after knocking her out with his glove stunners. After escaping the Republic Detention Center and landing on Nal Hutta, Bane equipped himself with a new pair of gauntlets, a new LL-30 pistol in a holster on his right leg, and a [[GALAAR-15 blaster carbine]] which he kept in a holster on his back. He also had a [[WESTAR-35 blaster pistol]], which he later gave to Kenobi (who was disguised as Rako Hardeen). His left gauntlet had a [[knockout gas]] dispenser that could discombobulate his enemies. His right gauntlet had a [[whipcord launcher]] that could ensnare targets.{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/friends-and-enemies-episode-gallery|text="Friends and Enemies" Episode Gallery}} [[File:CadBane-2025MercUnit.png|thumb|300px|left|Bane wore rocket boots and wielded dual LL-30 blasters.]] He also had [[Breath mask|breathing tubes]], which enabled him to survive being [[Force choke]]d, and rocket boots to help him keep up with the Force-imbued Jedi.{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/hostage-crisis-episode-guide|text="Hostage Crisis" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} Bane owned several starships. From his payment from Darth Sidious, he obtain a modified [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter|''Rogue''-class Porax-38 starfighter]] called ''Xanadu Blood''. The Trade Federation loaned him a [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigate]]. Later, by the Imperial Era, Bane flew a [[Justifier-class assault transport|''Justifier''-class assault transport]] called the ''Justifier''. While operating as a class one bounty hunter, Bane used a small device that measures a person's M-count level. This is done by taking a person's blood sample and putting it in the device to be scanned. If the light on the device flashes green, the person has a high M-count. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Something you notice about George Lucas after a while is that he'll mention a name like 'Mace Windu' in a ''[1973]'' version of ''Star Wars'', and then it pops up in 1999. So, this, I guess might have been an idea George had for the character Cad Bane ''way'' back when, and now finally he's getting around to bringing him to the screen in ''The Clone Wars''.|Supervising Director Dave Filoni on the origins of Cad Bane|{{DB|character|cadbane|Bane, Cad}}}} [[File:FACadBane.png|thumb|right|200px|Cad Bane in ''Star Wars: Force Arena'']] Initial development of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series focused on presenting the conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Separatists, leaving no room for third-party villains, but as the storyline progressed, the need for a bounty hunter character emerged. Supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] and writer [[Henry Gilroy]] initially considered reusing the [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] bounty hunter [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] from the [[2003]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' cartoon. Filoni wanted to keep the character's all-concealing armor, George Lucas, however, had a different design in mind for the bounty hunter: he gave the character a new name and wanted him to be a gunslinger, like the characters played by [[Wikipedia:Lee Van Cleef|Lee Van Cleef]], crossed with the Duros species.''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' During this research, Filoni came across early concept art of a gun-toting spacer wearing a hat in drafts of the original ''[[Star Wars]]'' trilogy. According to Dave Filoni, Bane's iconic toothpick was originally intended to be a cigarette, but the idea was dropped due to its negative and commercial-like message.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Four|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Four]]< [[File:CadBane-AG.png|thumb|left|200px|Cad Bane's live action design]] [[Corey Burton]], who also voiced Ziro the Hutt and Count Dooku,{{TCW|Massacre}} provided Cad Bane's voice, which was based on Lance Henriksen's performance with an impression of Peter Lorre's iconic voice. According to Burton, Henriksen was originally cast as the voice of Cad Bane before Burton was chosen by George Lucas.https://youtu.be/bNT-WEv8uS4 Before the cancellation of ''The Clone Wars'' TV series, Cad Bane was set to make an appearance during a [[The Clone Wars Legacy#Bounty Hunter Arc|four-episode arc]] starring him and Boba Fett. The two were going to team up for a "rescue mission" on Tatooine where [[Tusken Raider]]s had kidnapped a child. It would emphasize Boba's and Cad's relation to one another, as Cad had known Jango. Cad Bane would also get new [[Clothing|clothes]] and a new ship called the ''[[Justifier]]''.{{SWYouTube|7yKM6RExLlI|The Untold Clone Wars Panel | Star Wars Celebration Anaheim}} In a clip revealed during the Animated Origins and Unexpected Fates panel at [[Celebration Orlando]] in 2017, Cad Bane and other bounty hunters had ended an insurrection by Fett. To finish it, they engaged in a stand-off duel, where Bane’s LL-30 blaster pistol caused the younger mercenary to get a dent on his helmet, but Fett managed to shoot Bane with both his dual [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol]]s.{{SWYouTube|85Jw-63YNYI|Star Wars Celebration Orlando 2017: Animated Origins and Unexpected Fates}} Following the cancellation of ''The Clone Wars'', Bane appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[Fighter Flight]]" in the form of [[graffiti]] done by [[Sabine Wren]] on the ''[[Ghost]]''. Bane later returned in the animated series [[Star Wars: The Bad Batch|''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'']], once again voiced by Burton. Bane made his live-action debut in "[[Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger]]," the sixth episode of the [[2021]] [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]''. He was physically portrayed by [[Dorian Kingi]] and voiced by Corey Burton. There was much debate behind the scenes for how to color Bane's blue skin.{{WebCite|url=https://www.thewrap.com/ahsoka-thrawn-star-wars-blue-skin-lars-mikkelsen|text='Ahsoka' Showrunner: Getting Grand
